verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a passing reference that customers must be linked 'to at least one account via Connect', which implies a first-party account-linking flow exists. Nothing describes its hosted or drop-in nature, how it is invoked, or what it returns. The token items describe partner API access tokens, not connected-account tokens, so they do not support this story. Missing for 10: documentation of server-side session/URL generation, a drop-in or hosted widget SDK and how to open it, the callback or token returned for the connected account, the institution search UI being provided, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
